title: Senior Backend Developer
description: ABOUT Jotform Jotform is a San Francisco-based SaaS company with more than 35 million users worldwide. We are thriving and growing, and we’ve never needed outside funding. That’s because we like keeping things agile, independent and fun. Jotform believes everyone should be able to create their own online forms. Our 10,000+ ready-made form templates, 100+ integrations and more than 380 widgets have made us one of the most popular online form builders for organizations of all sizes — from small businesses to enterprises. Since our inception in 2006, our mission has been to help users create, manage and share online forms and receive responses in the easiest way possible. ABOUT THE ROLE Jotform is seeking a Senior Backend Developer in our Ankara office, located at a relaxed fun environment in Hacettepe University Teknokent. As a rapidly growing company we are hiring for similar positions continuously and once an opportunity matches with your qualifications, we will contact you immediately. Here’s what you will be doing: Work closely with product management, front end developers, devOps and designers Design, build and deploy new features for Jotform Deliver solutions in a continuous integration flow to production having 35 million users Review and iterate architecture to ensure scale along with the growth Education & Work Experience & Technical Requirements: BS Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related technical field or equivalent practical experience Experience in building web applications Proficiency in PHP Familiarity with Distributed Systems programming Experience in SaaS and high traffic applications are highly preferred Understanding of HTML, CSS, Javascript, React and other web technologies Solid understanding of OOP principles Working experience with CI/CD and related tools like Git and Jenkins Ability to write high-performance, maintainable and reusable code Excellent command of English Personal Specifications/Skills: Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision A passion to learn and keep up with the latest technologies Jotform PERKS High growth-paced environment with collaborative and unique team culture Generous market competitive total compensation package Health Insurance Professional Growth & Career Opportunities: We support your personal and professional development with educational materials and expenses & relevant conferences abroad to stay up to date with the latest industry trends & online courses or coaching - and support you pursuing ones that you are passionate about! Challenging projects, regular feedback, healthy competition Fun & Relax working environment: When we’re in the office; music, jeans and t-shirts are the norm & kitchens stocked with healthy & tasty snacks & drinks OUR PROCESS We’ll review your application along with all the others we receive and pick the top profiles for a screening call. In many cases due to time constraints and our candidate volume, only the short-listed candidates are contacted but we do consider each application carefully. If you have been selected as a short-listed candidate, we will contact you for a short screening call to get to know you better. If you don’t get a call, please don’t be disappointed! We receive many applications for each role and have to prioritize who we speak to. Thank you for taking the time to apply for a position at Jotform! Jotform is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. https://www.jotform.com/job-applicant-privacy/

title: SQL & Backend Developer Stajyeri
description: Pozisyon Hakkında Firmamız bünyesinde C# ve SQL kullanarak yeni yazılım ürünlerinin geliştirilmesinde görev alacak bir SQL & Backend Developer Stajyeri arıyoruz. Bu pozisyonda, geliştirilecek ürünlerde ve mevcut platformumuza eklenecek özelliklerin geliştirme süreçlerinde aktif olarak rol alacaksınız. Süre: 6 Ay (Uzun Dönem) Çalışma Şekli: Full Time (Ofis) Lokasyon: İstanbul – Suadiye (Ofis) Ulaşım: Ofisimiz Suadiye Marmaray ve M8 Ayşekadın istasyonlarına yakın konumdadır. Kariyer Fırsatı: Program sürecinde başarılı bulunan adaylar, performansa bağlı olarak maaşlı şekilde ekibimizde devam etme fırsatı elde edecektir. Biz kimiz? B2B STORE, kurumsal müşterilere yönelik SaaS tabanlı yazılım çözümleri geliştiren bir teknoloji şirketidir. Ne Yapacaksınız? C# ile yeni ürünlerin yazılım süreçlerini sıfırdan kurgulamak ve geliştirmek. SQL sorguları ve stored procedure’ler geliştirmek. Mevcut platformumuza yönelik yeni özelliklerin geliştirilmesine katkı sağlamak. Yazılım ihtiyaçlarını değerlendirerek çözümler ve yeni özellik önerileri sunmak. Geliştirme sürecinde yapay zeka araçlarını aktif kullanmak; çıktıyı analiz ederek ürüne uygun şekilde çalışır hâle getirmek. Yapılan çalışmaları JIRA/benzeri araçlar üzerinden takip etmek ve dokümante etmek. Aradığımız Profil: C# ile çalışan bir uygulama geliştirebilecek düzeyde bilgi sahibi olan, SQL ile sorgu yazabilen ve stored procedure yapısını bilen, TypeScript (Vue.js, React veya Angular) konusunda temel bilgi sahibi, daha önce arayüz geliştirmeleri yapmış veya katkıda bulunmuş olan, Yazılım ihtiyaçlarını anlayarak çözüm üretebilen ve bu çözümleri hayata geçirebilen, Analiz yeteneği güçlü, detaylara önem veren, Öğrenmeye açık ve takım çalışmasına yatkın. Tercih Sebebi Yazılım Mühendisliği veya ilgili bir bölümden mezun olmak. Okul ya da kişisel projelerinde C# ve SQL kullanarak çalışan bir uygulama geliştirmiş olmak Yazılım projelerine ilgili, bu alanda kariyer hedefleyen Neler Sunuyoruz? 6 ay boyunca gerçek projelerde çalışma imkanı Mentor desteği ve düzenli geri bildirim Kurumsal disiplinde süreç ve veri odaklı çalışma deneyimi Başarılı adaylar için maaşlı devam / kadroya geçiş fırsatı

title: Senior PHP Developer
description: Role Description As a PHP Developer at our customer, you will play a key role in developing and maintaining software solutions. Leveraging your expertise in backend, frontend, and infrastructure development, you will contribute to every development lifecycle stage. We seek a professional with strong technical skills, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to delivering high-quality, sustainable solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design innovative solutions. Optimize application performance and system architecture. Ensure high code quality and maintainability through adherence to best practices. Skillset RequirementsBackend Development: Proficient in PHP with extensive experience in Symfony Framework . Skilled in using PHPSpec for behavior-driven development and PHPStan for static code analysis. Strong knowledge of MySQL for efficient database management. Experience with Redis for caching and session management. Frontend Development: Proficient in JavaScript with hands-on experience in modern frameworks. Expertise in VueJS or NuxtJS for building interactive and scalable front-end applications. API Development: Strong experience in reading and writing OpenAPI Specifications (OAS) for API design and documentation. Proficient in GraphQL for writing queries, mutations, and subscriptions. DevOps & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Docker for containerization and managing environments. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for automating build, test, and deployment workflows. Key Competencies Strong knowledge of software development best practices, including SOLID principles and design patterns. Proficient in version control systems like Git . Familiarity with testing frameworks and tools. Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and a focus on code quality. Experience with scalable system architectures and performance optimization techniques. Soft Skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Turkish. Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. Application Process: If you meet the requirements of this role and would like to find out more about this opportunity, please apply to role with an updated CV.

title: Backend Developer – Oracle PL/SQL & Python
description: Mavidev; bankacılık, fintech, sigorta ve e-ticaret alanlarındaki kurumsal müşterilere yazılım geliştirme ve danışmanlık hizmeti veren bir teknoloji şirketidir. Müşterimizin ekibinde görevlendirilmek üzere, Oracle / PL-SQL ve Python tarafında güçlü deneyime sahip bir Backend Developer arıyoruz. Görev ve Sorumluluklar - Oracle veritabanı üzerinde PL/SQL ile stored procedure, function, package ve trigger geliştirmek - Mevcut SQL ve PL/SQL kodlarını analiz etmek, iyileştirmek ve performans optimizasyonu yapmak - Python ile servis, entegrasyon ve veri işleme süreçleri geliştirmek - REST API'ler geliştirmek ve üçüncü parti sistemlerle entegrasyonları yürütmek - Production sorunlarının analizine ve çözümüne katkı sağlamak Aradığımız Nitelikler - En az 5 yıl yazılım geliştirme deneyimi - Oracle Database üzerinde güçlü ve aktif geliştirme deneyimi - PL/SQL ve SQL konusunda ileri seviye bilgi - Karmaşık SQL sorguları geliştirebilme ve mevcut sorguları analiz edebilme - SQL ve PL/SQL performans optimizasyonu deneyimi - Python ile backend uygulama geliştirme konusunda güçlü ve aktif deneyim - REST API geliştirme ve üçüncü parti sistem entegrasyonu deneyimi - Mevcut kodu analiz edebilme, hata ayıklayabilme ve sürdürülebilir şekilde geliştirebilme - Git, Linux/Unix ortamları ve unit test konusunda pratik deneyim - Yazılım geliştirme yaşam döngüsü, CI/CD ve kurumsal geliştirme süreçleri hakkında bilgi - Clean Code ve kod kalitesi prensiplerine önem veren bir yaklaşım Tercih Sebebi - Java, Kafka, Jenkins ve OpenShift ile çalışma deneyimi veya aşinalık - Finans, bankacılık veya yüksek işlem hacimli kurumsal sistemlerde geliştirme deneyimi Diğer Yetkinlikler - Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme becerisi - Karmaşık mevcut sistemleri ve kod yapılarını hızlı kavrayabilme - Teknik konuları ekip içinde açık ve anlaşılır şekilde aktarabilme - Takım çalışmasına yatkınlık ve sorumluluk bilinci - Gerektiğinde bağımsız çalışarak teknik problemleri uçtan uca takip edebilme - Agile/Scrum çalışma yöntemlerine uyum Çalışma Şekli - Tam zamanlı, uzaktan (remote) çalışma - Türkiye'de ikamet eden adaylar Başvurular kapsamında paylaşılan kişisel veriler, 6698 sayılı KVKK kapsamında yalnızca işe alım süreci amacıyla işlenecektir.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: ABOUT FIGTURES Figtures is a product studio building AI-powered products, SaaS platforms, and enterprise software. We partner with startups and established organizations across healthcare, hospitality, education, e-commerce, and industrial sectors, delivering products from discovery through production. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our engineering team on a contract basis. You will work on production systems serving real users, own technical decisions end to end, and contribute to the architectural standards that govern our delivery. RESPONSIBILITIES · Design, build, and maintain production features across frontend and backend · Define component architecture and shared libraries used across multiple products · Integrate REST and GraphQL services with type-safe contracts generated from OpenAPI specifications · Write unit and end-to-end tests as an integral part of feature delivery · Document architectural decisions and technical rationale · Participate in code review and uphold engineering standards across the team · Monitor and optimize application performance, including bundle size and Core Web Vitals QUALIFICATIONS · 5+ years of professional software engineering experience · Advanced proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript · Production experience with Next.js or comparable frameworks · Backend development experience with Node.js or equivalent · Demonstrated experience with automated testing frameworks · Strong understanding of state management, caching strategies, and API design · Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly in written form · Professional working proficiency in English and Turkish PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS · Experience with monorepo tooling (Turborepo, Nx, or similar) · React Native or cross-platform mobile development · Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture and role-based access control · Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and performance budgeting · Background in enterprise or ERP systems WHAT WE OFFER · Fully remote work with flexible scheduling · Project-based engagement with scope and commitment defined collaboratively · Above-market compensation aligned with seniority and scope · Direct ownership of technical decisions without layers of approval · Engineering culture grounded in documentation, testing, and code review Figtures is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability status. https://figtures.com
